verdicts.quote: Pain on the outside of the knee on downhills is often the IT band getting cranky, so a few minutes with a foam roller on the outer thigh before runs might take the edge off.
verdicts.why: Names a likely condition (IT band) and recommends a treatment (foam rolling) for reported knee pain.
No weight, body shape, or earning/burning language; avoid_weight_talk is false.
Starts with first name, ends with coach name, specific to the week, no guilt or hype.
Facts match data; pain is acknowledged and coach contact promised, though advice is the rule 1 issue.
